name: FineWeb-Edu
description: Educational web content filtered using an educational classifier, focusing on middle-school to grade-school knowledge while retaining high-level content.

name: TxT360
description: Trillion-scale extracted text dataset, globally deduplicated 99 CommonCrawl snapshots and 14 non-web sources, providing high-quality data for LLM pretraining.

name: FineWeb 2
description: Multilingual dataset supporting over 1,000 languages and scripts, built on 96 Common Crawl snapshots spanning 2013‑2024, containing ~3 trillion words.

name: Common Corpus
description: Over 2 trillion tokens from diverse sources, filtered for toxicity and curated for ethical standards, used for pretraining models like GPT and BERT.

name: Cosmopedia
description: Synthetic dataset of 30 million samples generated by Mixtral‑8x7B‑Instruct‑v0.1, covering educational resources, blog posts, and synthetic instruction data.

name: HelpSteer2
description: 21k samples with detailed annotations focusing on helpfulness and correctness, used for preference‑based training of chatbots.

name: Orca-AgentInstruct-1M-v1
description: One million synthetically generated instruction pairs covering text editing, coding, and comprehension tasks.

name: SmolTalkDataset
description: Synthetic dataset for supervised fine‑tuning, covering mathematics, coding, and summarization tasks.

name: FinePersonas
description: 21 million detailed personas generated for diverse and controllable synthetic text generation, grounded in educational content.

name: FineVideo
description: Video understanding dataset focusing on mood analysis, storytelling, and editing.
